reference.title: WH-guide-N4Install
reference.shortdesc: Reusable content for the Niagara 4 Installation Guide.

section.note: The Daemon User Home and the User Home are intended to be installed in distinctly separate locations. This separation of homes is for security reasons but it also prevents certain unintended results. For example, when the two homes are installed in the same location the Station Copier becomes unavailable, and you will not be able to make a portable copy of the station.
